metadata.title: Production-harden jira sync command
metadata.description: Fix flag handling and exit codes in 'pm jira sync' so preview mode is honored, --max-results works, and failures exit non-zero.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

features/pm-jira-xfd9.toon.body: Hands-on functional test pass with real CLI invocation and stubbed Jira API. Found and fixed 3 real bugs of the known classes (option normalization, exit codes, field mapping). See child Issues.

metadata.title: description (ADF) and priority fetched but never written to pm items
metadata.author: codex

issues/pm-jira-1aqg.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: synced pm items had no body and no priority. The Jira API response includes description (Atlassian Document Format) and priority, and the code even defined adfToPlainText() and mapJiraPriority() — but both were DEAD CODE; the pm create spawn passed only --title/--status/--type/--tags. Real-world data (long descriptions, priorities, due dates) was silently dropped.

REPRO: sync any project; inspect created item -> body empty, priority defaulted.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed body/priority/deadline missing; expected mapped from Jira.

FIX: write path (command + importer) now passes --priority (mapJiraPriority), --body (adfToPlainText of description) when present, and --deadline from fields.duedate. Missing optional fields handled (priority defaults to 3; body/deadline/tags omitted when absent). Verified via stubbed-network + real pm create: stored item has priority:2, body:DESC-BODY-MARKER, deadline:2026-06-15, tags:lbl1,v9.

metadata.title: dry-run/max-results flags read kebab keys; --dry-run silently writes
metadata.author: codex

issues/pm-jira-dhsn.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: `pm jira sync --project PROJ --dry-run` does NOT preview — it executes the write path and creates pm items. Same for --max-results being ignored (always 500).

REPRO: pm jira sync --project PROJ --dry-run (with valid creds). Items get created despite dry-run.

ROOT CAUSE: pm CLI normalizes loose extension flags to camelCase (extension-command-options.js toLooseOptionKey: --dry-run -> dryRun, --max-results -> maxResults). Code read ctx.options['dry-run'] / ['max-results'] (kebab) which are always undefined -> dryRun=false -> write path taken. Proven: probe showed ctx.options['dry-run']=undefined, ctx.options['dryRun']=true.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed = silent writes during 'preview'; expected = no writes, preview only.

FIX: added readStringOption/readNumberOption/readBooleanOption helpers that check BOTH kebab and camelCase keys; applied to project/jql/max-results/dry-run/status in both command and importer. Verified via stubbed-network probe: dry-run now makes 0 pm create calls and returns dryRun:true.

metadata.title: sync failures return {success:false} instead of throwing -> exit code 0
metadata.author: codex

issues/pm-jira-lk24.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: missing credentials, missing --project/--jql, and Jira fetch failures all returned { success:false, error } from run(), which the CLI treats as a successful command -> exit code 0. A CI/script chaining on exit status proceeds as if the sync succeeded.

REPRO: unset JIRA_BASE_URL JIRA_API_TOKEN JIRA_EMAIL; pm jira sync --project PROJ >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $? -> 0 (before fix).

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed exit 0 on failure; expected non-zero.

FIX: replaced the three `return { success:false, ... }` paths with `throw new Error(...)`. Verified live after fix: no-creds=1, no-project=1, fetch-failure=1.

metadata.title: Failures exited 0 (missing creds / no project / fetch error)
metadata.description: Three paths returned { success:false, error }, which the runtime treats as success (exit 0). Switched to throwing so the CLI exits non-zero; also fail when every create fails.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

metadata.title: --dry-run silently wrote items instead of previewing
metadata.description: Flag read as ctx.options['dry-run'] but runtime normalizes to camelCase 'dryRun'; dry-run was always false so 'preview' created real pm items. Now reads both keys via optionEnabled().
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

metadata.title: --max-results ignored (always 500)
metadata.description: Read as ctx.options['max-results'] (runtime uses 'maxResults') and never coerced from string. Now read via optionInt() across both keys with integer coercion.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

metadata.title: Release readiness hardening for pm-jira
metadata.description: Prepare pm-jira as a production-ready pm package with package-local pm tracking, generated changelog data, CI and daily release automation.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.acceptance_criteria: Package installs with pm install; npm release gate passes; changelog is generated from package-local pm data; tracked files and reachable git history have no secret pattern hits.

tasks/pm-jira-5d71.toon.body: Implemented release-ready package metadata and automation for pm-jira using the latest pm CLI 2026.5.24 and pm SDK contracts. Added local pm project tracking, CI/release workflows, pm-changelog integration, TypeScript checks, production audit gates, dry-run packaging, installability metadata, and registry metadata. Verified no private tokens or personal files are present in tracked files or reachable git history before release preparation.

metadata.title: Add bun-install verification to release workflow
metadata.description: Smoke-test that the just-published npm package installs cleanly via bun via daily release workflow.
metadata.author: codex

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.
metadata.author: codex
